findings.text: follow-on: _file_stamp duplicates the existing file_stamp at reckon/capabilities.py:1210 (a [mtime_ns, size] stamp of one path, None when absent) rather than extending it, so the two stat-based change detectors can drift; follow-on because the copy is small and both behave correctly.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against the base 5137df57: 02ff96009 adds _lane_gate_hold and the pre-release gate hold; e68332991 adds _retry_delay, _is_lane_hold and _retry_backoff_hold with the back-off branch; 2baab2b6a adds _file_stamp, _dependency_guard, _report_queued_failure and _stamp_failure and the one-time report; 1096ac7af and b000cdc72 record the fragment; nothing outside the three declared files is touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names tests/tests/test_a_held_request_stays_queued.py; the manifest records the gate on the new file as 6 passed (gate-head-3.log, EXIT=0) and the importing arm tests/test_a_queued_run_is_admitted.py as 18 passed (gate-importing-head-3.log, EXIT=0), and the held-case negative control is negative-control.log (EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that admit_once leave a queued request untouched while the lane would still hold it, so a request the lane keeps is never withdrawn and re-queued; reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:189 (_lane_gate_hold, called at :553) asks the lane gate before the pointer is released, and :334 (_retry_backoff_hold, called at :562) leaves a request whose last attempt failed for a non-lane reason in place, both matching the goal.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete; five commits 02ff96009, e68332991, 1096ac7af, 2baab2b6a, b000cdc72; the structured baseline_suite and after_suite fields are empty, so the added-failure count was derived from the ran arms' own gate logs, gate-importing-base.log (18 passed) and gate-importing-head-3.log (18 passed), giving 0 added.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the dispatch fenced reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, tests/test_a_held_request_stays_queued.py, the fragment docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches/a-held-request-stays-queued.html and the figures directory; git diff --name-only 5137df57..b000cdc72 lists exactly those three files and nothing else, so the land sits inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: the assertions at tests/test_a_held_request_stays_queued.py:106-107 and :190-192 compare the pointer bytes and stream rows against snapshots taken before the pass rather than against a value the test supplied to the code, and negative-control.log shows them reddening (2 failed, EXIT=1) once the pre-release hold is removed, so the guard is exercised by reinstating the defect.
justifications.evidence: the gate the done-when names ran (tests/test_a_held_request_stays_queued.py, gate-head-3.log, 6 passed, EXIT=0) and its assertions cover both the held-unchanged case (:106-107) and the launches-once-open case (:145-147), with the importing arm recorded at 18 passed.
justifications.fit: the added helpers _lane_gate_hold, _retry_backoff_hold and _stamp_failure follow the module's private-underscore idiom and carry no plan, sprint or ticket identifier (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:189, :334, :375).
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:553 holds a gate-refused request before the release, so a request the lane still holds keeps its run id and queued phase and the pane appends no transition, exactly the goal.
justifications.reuse: _file_stamp at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:241 re-implements the stat-based change stamp the repository already owns at reckon/capabilities.py:1210 (file_stamp) instead of calling it.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 5137df57..b000cdc72 lists only reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, tests/test_a_held_request_stays_queued.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared write paths.
